## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复创建实例绑定 ChatGPT 登录账号时默认模型为空的问题。按绑定账号从官方 Codex 接口读取模型列表，使用所选客户端的实际 CLI 版本和账号网络代理，并按官方可见模型的推荐顺序填入默认值。
- 官方列表使用短时、隔离的缓存，提供刷新入口。获取失败时明确显示正在使用内置备用目录，仍可手动填写模型 ID；刷新失败不会丢弃本次已获取的官方列表。
- 供应商连接保留自己的模型列表，不请求 ChatGPT 目录。编辑、复制和手动填写的模型不会被延迟结果覆盖，切换账号、客户端程序或关闭窗口会取消旧查询。
- 增加官方目录鉴权、刷新、取消、超时、账号隔离和真实创建向导的回归验证。不会将模型目录写回账号凭据或更改现有会话。

- Fixed empty default models when creating an instance with a ChatGPT login account. The manager reads account-scoped models from the official Codex endpoint using the selected client's actual CLI version and the account's network proxy, then selects the first visible model in official priority order.
- Official lists use short-lived, isolated caches and can be refreshed. Retrieval failures clearly identify the built-in fallback; manual IDs remain available. A failed refresh retains the current draft's previously retrieved official list.
- Provider connections keep their own model lists. Typed and saved models in edited or copied instances are preserved. Changing accounts or client applications, or closing the dialog, cancels the previous lookup.
- Added regression coverage for official discovery, authentication, refresh, cancellation, timeouts, account isolation and the real creation wizard. Account credentials and existing conversations are retained.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。安装前停止实例并退出旧管理器；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Stop instances and quit the old manager before installing; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex。Claude Code、Claude Desktop 及其他客户端仍为计划接入。客户端需单独安装；界面兼容与 Fast 的实际支持取决于客户端、模型和供应商。

Codex is currently supported. Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other clients remain planned integrations. Clients must be installed separately; UI compatibility and Fast depend on the client, model and provider.

源码对应标签 [`v0.4.5`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.5)，安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

Source corresponds to tag [`v0.4.5`](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.4.5); installer checksums are in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
